title: Il se promène, lisant au livre de lui-même,
html_source:
From Crayonne de Theatre .The reader becomes aware of Joyce with this line as Mallarmé argued all writing is theatrical and this has been alluded to in a chapter from Ulysses riddled with stage references.

The line was written by Mallarmé, a note scribbled whilst watching Hamlet in France in an attempt to distinguish the characteristics of Hamlet from those of Fortinbras. It infers a Hamlet concerned only with himself and introduces a psychoanalytical approach to the analysis of Hamlet.
